convert.warn.nozzle_changed: source nozzle {source} → target {target}; check line widths
convert.warn.filament_unused: {message}; it is not used on any plate, its source values are kept
convert.warn.map_auto_e34: extruders 3–4 are used: the assignment is set to automatic mode because OrcaSlicer rejects manual mode on them; the slicer confirms the planned assignment when slicing
convert.warn.map_manual_e34: the manual assignment uses extruders 3–4: Flash Studio accepts it, OrcaSlicer 2.5 rejects it when slicing
convert.note.volumetric: The target filament allows {cap} mm³/s; the slicer caps these model speeds by itself, without changing the setting: {items}
reason.gcode_no_equivalent: source G-code with no equivalent in the target
reason.author_on_process: model's setting on top of the process profile
reason.author: model's setting
reason.first_layer: project's first layer height (thin objects depend on it)
reason.cooling: cooling depends on the printer's fans; the target profile applies
reason.cooling_no_value: cooling depends on the printer's fans; the target profile applies (no value in the target)
reason.author_filament_replaced: the model's setting for this filament depends on the source printer's hardware or calibration; the target filament profile applies
reason.filament_printable: each filament can use any of the {count} extruders
reason.extruder_colour: colour of the filament assigned to each extruder
reason.author_on_presets: model's settings on top of the target presets
reason.invalid_in_orca: value not valid in OrcaSlicer; OrcaSlicer's default applies
reason.recentered: recentred on the target build plate
reason.variant_value: value of the '{variant}' variant (the target has only one)
map.error.entry_numbers: invalid filament map entry '{entry}' (must be numbers)
map.error.repeated: filament {filament} appears twice in the filament map
map.error.missing: the filament map does not assign filaments {filaments}
map.error.unknown: the filament map mentions filaments that do not exist {filaments} (the project has {count})
map.error.out_of_range: the filament map assigns extruders outside 1..{extruders} to filaments {filaments}
map.error.mixed_types: extruder {extruder} gets filaments of different types {types} (filaments {filaments})
map.error.too_many: plate {plate} uses {count} filaments {filaments} but the printer has {extruders} extruders{detail}; assign the extruders manually
map.error.usage_unknown: (usage cannot be determined: colour painting or layer changes)
map.warn.shared_extruder: plate {plate}: filaments {filaments} share extruder {extruder}; a manual spool change is needed during the print
write.error.same_as_source: the output cannot be the original file
write.error.not_zip: the output is not a valid ZIP: {detail}
profiles.error.root_not_found: the slicer profiles folder was not found (tried: {tried}). Use --profiles-dir or the {env} variable.
cli.description: Convert a 3MF project for another printer.
cli.help.map: filament:extruder pairs separated by commas, e.g. 1:1,2:2,5:1
cli.help.out: output file or folder (default: next to the original)
cli.help.report: JSON report path (default: next to the output)
cli.help.force: overwrite the output if it exists
cli.error.original_changed: the original file changed during the conversion
convert.error.already_target: the project is already set up for {target}
cli.help.printer: target printer preset (name or a unique part of it); list them with `printnomad printers`
cli.help.slicer: slicer whose profiles to use (default: search the installed ones)
cli.error.no_printer: choose the target printer with --printer (see `printnomad printers`)
reason.author_filament_kept: the model's material choice for this filament (temperature or density)
cli.help.no_designer_filament: do not keep the model's filament temperatures and density; use the target filament profiles as they are
cli.printers.description: List the printer presets (system and yours) of the installed slicers.
cli.printers.help.search: only presets whose name contains this text
cli.printers.help.all: also list presets whose profiles are incomplete in that slicer
convert.note.map_compatible: filament-to-extruder assignment left to the slicer (automatic mode) so the project slices in any Orca-based slicer; the planned assignment is the suggested one
convert.warn.designer_cooling: the model's cooling values were kept ({keys}): fan percentages refer to the source printer's fans, which may be stronger, weaker or numbered differently; check overhangs and layer adhesion
option.map_mode.label: Filament assignment
option.map_mode.help: How filaments are tied to extruders in the converted project.
option.map_mode.compatible: Compatible: the slicer finalises the assignment (works in every slicer)
option.map_mode.slicer: Depends on the slicer: exact unless the chosen slicer rejects it
option.map_mode.warning: OrcaSlicer 2.5 refuses to slice a manual assignment on extruders 3–4; use this with Flash Studio or when you need a specific extruder for each filament.
option.keep_designer_filament.label: Keep the model's filament temperatures
option.keep_designer_filament.help: Nozzle and bed temperatures and density set in the model are kept on top of your printer's filament profile.
option.keep_designer_cooling.label: Keep the model's cooling values
option.keep_designer_cooling.help: Fan and cooling values set in the model are kept instead of your printer's profile values.
option.keep_designer_cooling.warning: Fan percentages are relative to each printer's fans. A printer with stronger or more fans can over-cool (weak layer adhesion, warping in PETG/ABS) or under-cool (sagging overhangs and bridges). Use it only when the model's cooling is essential.
cli.help.designer_cooling: keep the model's cooling values (fans differ between printers: check the result)
reason.printer_setting: depends on the printer (accelerations, calibration, arc fitting, file name); the target profile applies
convert.warn.designer_printer_settings: the model's printer-dependent settings were kept ({keys}): they were chosen for the source printer; check the first layer and dimensions
option.keep_designer_printer_settings.la: Also keep the model's printer settings
option.keep_designer_printer_settings.he: Accelerations, elephant foot and XY compensation, first-layer flow, arc fitting and the G-code file name set in the model are kept instead of your printer's profile values.
option.keep_designer_printer_settings.wa: These values were chosen for the source printer: accelerations follow its motion system and calibration values (elephant foot, XY compensation, first-layer flow) belong to that machine, not yours.
report.source_defaults: Source preset defaults removed (the slicer applies its own): {count}
report.not_changed: Marked as changed but equal to the source preset ({count}, not treated as the designer's): {keys}
convert.warn.filament_not_printable: Plate {plate}: filament #{filament} ({type}) is assigned to E{extruder}, but its printer maker's profile only allows {allowed}. The slicer will refuse to slice: move it to {allowed}.
reason.filament_printable_repaired: the value came from a profile made for another printer; this filament can use {allowed}
report.repaired: The project was already set up for this printer: only values that would stop it slicing were fixed.
